mapper.sql: pmio.id id,pmio.org_id orgId,pmio.patient_id patientId,pmio.member_type_id memberTypeId,pmio.master_card masterCard,pmio.card_number cardNumber, pmio.status status,pmio.principal_amount principalAmount,pmio.bonus_amount bonusAmount,pmio.point point,pmio.last_expired_time lastExpiredTime, pmio.next_expired_time nextExpiredTime,pmio.remarks remarks,pmio.inservice inservice
mapper.select: (select mer.crt_name consumerName,1 type ,DATE_FORMAT(mer.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') operatingTime, (mer.expend_principal+mer.expend_gift) rechargePrincipal from member_expend_record mer left JOIN patient_base_info pbi on mer.patient_id = pbi.id where mer.inservice = 1 and DATE_FORMAT(mer.crt_time,'%Y-%m') > DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month),'%Y-%m') and mer.member_id = #{memberId} and mer.patient_id = #{patientId} ) UNION (select crt_name consumerName, 0 type,DATE_FORMAT(crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') operatingTime,(recharge_principal+recharge_bonus) rechargePrincipal from member_recharge_record where inservice = 1 and type = 0 and DATE_FORMAT(crt_time,'%Y-%m') > DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month),'%Y-%m') and member_id = #{memberId} ) UNION (select mrr.crt_name consumerName,2 type,DATE_FORMAT(mrr.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') operatingTime,mrr.actual_return_amount rechargePrincipal from member_return_record mrr left JOIN patient_base_info pbi on mrr.patient_id = pbi.id where mrr.inservice = 1 and DATE_FORMAT(mrr.crt_time,'%Y-%m') > DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month),'%Y-%m') and mrr.member_id = #{memberId} and mrr.patient_id = #{patientId} )

(select mer.crt_name consumerName,1 type ,DATE_FORMAT(mer.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') operatingTime, (mer.expend_principal+mer.expend_gift) rechargePrincipal from prepaid_expend_record mer left JOIN patient_base_info pbi on mer.patient_id = pbi.id where mer.inservice = 1 and DATE_FORMAT(mer.crt_time,'%Y-%m') > DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month),'%Y-%m') and mer.prepaid_id = #{memberId} and mer.patient_id = #{patientId} ) UNION (select crt_name consumerName, 0 type,DATE_FORMAT(crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') operatingTime,(recharge_principal+recharge_bonus) rechargePrincipal from prepaid_recharge_record where inservice = 1 and type = 0 and DATE_FORMAT(crt_time,'%Y-%m') > DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month),'%Y-%m') and prepaid_id = #{memberId} ) UNION (select mrr.crt_name consumerName,2 type,DATE_FORMAT(mrr.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') operatingTime,mrr.actual_return_amount rechargePrincipal from prepaid_return_record mrr left JOIN patient_base_info pbi on mrr.patient_id = pbi.id where mrr.inservice = 1 and DATE_FORMAT(mrr.crt_time,'%Y-%m') > DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month),'%Y-%m') and mrr.prepaid_id = #{memberId} and mrr.patient_id = #{patientId} )

select pmio.org_id orgId, pmio.patient_id, pmio.id,pmio.card_number cardNumber,pmio.member_type_id memberTypeId,pmio.crt_time crtTime,pbio.name name, CAST((pmio.principal_amount+pmio.bonus_amount) AS decimal(15,2)) memberCardMoneySum, CAST(IFNULL(pmio.principal_amount,0) AS decimal(15,2)) principalAmount, CAST(IFNULL(pmio.bonus_amount,0) AS decimal(15,2)) bonusAmount from patient_member_info pmio join patient_base_info pbio on pmio.patient_id = pbio.id where pmio.patient_id =#{id}

select pmr.id bindId,(select name from patient_base_info where id = pmr.secondary_card_id )name,pmr.master_card_id masterCardId, pmr.secondary_card_id secondaryCardId,pmr.bind_type bindType,pbi.face_url as faceUrl from patient_member_relation pmr join patient_base_info pbi on pmr.master_card_id = pbi.id where pmr.master_card_id = #{form.patientId} and bind_type = #{form.bindType}
select IF(card_number is null,'000000',substr( MAX(card_number), -6, 6 )) as maxnum from patient_member_info where left(card_number,1)='H' and org_id = #{orgId}
select IF(prepayment_number is null,'000000',substr( MAX(prepayment_number), -6, 6 )) as maxnum from patient_prepayments_info where left(prepayment_number,1)='Y' and org_id = #{orgId}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.card_number = #{cardNumber}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.card_number = #{memberCard}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.patient_id =#{patientId}

SELECT pmi.id, pmr.master_card_id AS patientId, pbi.`name`, pmi.member_type_id AS memberTypeId, pmi.card_number AS cardNumber, CAST( IFNULL( pmi.principal_amount + pmi.bonus_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) memberCardMoneySum, CAST( IFNULL( pmi.principal_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) principalAmount, CAST( IFNULL( pmi.bonus_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) bonusAmount FROM ( SELECT pmr.master_card_id FROM patient_member_relation pmr WHERE bind_type = 1 AND pmr.secondary_card_id = #{patientId} GROUP BY pmr.master_card_id ) pmr LEFT JOIN patient_member_info pmi ON pmr.master_card_id = pmi.patient_id LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbi ON pmr.master_card_id = pbi.id
